title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Sales Development agent books seller meetings for prospects
summary: Hold: Microsoft now documents a beta contract for activating agent templates and selecting who may create instances, so the blanket statement that no activation API is documented is no longer accurate. The reference does not establish deployed availability or identify the Sales Development agent's package, and those qualifications must be retained.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table and following activation paragraph
claims.claim: No API is documented for activating the Sales Development template or choosing who can create instances.
claims.quote:
Activate an already-onboarded agent template for the users or groups allowed to create instances from it, and apply the selected policy template.
This reference describes the reviewed beta contract.
claims.fix: Replace the blanket absence with: 'Microsoft documents POST /beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/activate as a reviewed beta contract for activating onboarded agent templates. agentManagerScope selects who may create instances and policyTemplateId selects the saved policy template. Availability depends on the matching schema and backend release; this reference does not confirm deployed availability or the Sales Development agent's package identifier.' Set controls[0].api to kind graph, that call, and docs https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-copilot/extensibility/api/admin-settings/package/copilotpackageactivationresult-activate; retain these qualifications in its note and rendered table. Cite the reference in sources.
